title: "About Me"
---

## Background & Expertise
I am a health economist and biostatistician with a PhD in Genetic Epidemiology from the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) and hands-on health technology assessment (HTA) appraisal experience at PenTAG, University of Exeter.

My core focus is on economic evaluation, health economic modelling, evidence synthesis (NMA, MAIC, STC), and real-world data (RWD) registry analyses to inform healthcare reimbursement and clinical decision-making.

## Passion & Hobbies
- **Open Source R & Tooling:** Building modular R packages, interactive R Shiny dashboards, and transparent health-analytics pipelines.
- **Methodological Research:** Exploring genetic epidemiology, polygenic risk scores (PRS), and causal inference methodologies in large biobank cohorts (HUNT, Norwegian Patient Registry).
- **Global Health & Science Communication:** Translating complex statistical evidence and registry analyses into accessible insights for clinicians, patients, and policy-makers.
